evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: On our own synchronized radar + RGB-D corpus with block-level held-out splits, the pipeline achieves 21.47 cm end-to-end (per-joint hierarchy from 4.8 cm at the hip to 34.7 cm at the wrist - matching physical information limits), could be improved to 15 cm with ~30k diverse samples, and a scaling law shows sample diversity, not volume, is the binding constraint.
